sections.title: 6.1 What are Embeddings?
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **Embeddings are numerical representations (lists of numbers) that capture the MEANING of text.**

### The Core Problem
Computers can't understand words. They only understand numbers. We need to convert:
```
"cat" → [0.2, -0.5, 0.8, 0.1, ...]   (a list of ~1536 numbers)
"dog" → [0.3, -0.4, 0.7, 0.2, ...]   (similar numbers because similar meaning!)
"car" → [0.9,  0.1, -0.2, 0.8, ...]  (very different numbers)
```

### The Magic: Similar Meaning = Similar Numbers

```
         HIGH-DIMENSIONAL SPACE (simplified to 2D here)
         
                    ↑ (abstract/concept)
                    │
         King  ●────────────● Queen
                    │
         Man   ●────────────● Woman
                    │
    ─────────────────────────────────→ (gender)
                    │
         Car   ●
                    │
         Truck ●
                    │
```

Words with similar meanings **cluster together** in this mathematical space!

### The Famous Example: Word Arithmetic
```
King - Man + Woman = Queen

Vector("King") - Vector("Man") + Vector("Woman") ≈ Vector("Queen")
```

This shows that embeddings capture **semantic relationships**!

### Types of Embeddings

| Type | What It Embeds | Use Case |
|------|---------------|----------|
| **Word Embeddings** | Single words | Basic NLP |
| **Sentence Embeddings** | Full sentences | Semantic search |
| **Document Embeddings** | Entire documents | Document similarity |
| **Image Embeddings** | Images | Image search |
| **Multimodal Embeddings** | Text + Images together | Cross-modal search |

### Practical Use Cases

**1. Semantic Search** (Search by MEANING, not keywords)
```
Query: "affordable places to stay"
Traditional search finds: "affordable places to stay" (exact match)
Embedding search finds: "cheap hotels", "budget accommodation", 
                        "inexpensive hostels" (same meaning!)
```

**2. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**
```
Step 1: Convert all your documents → embeddings → store in vector database
Step 2: User asks a question → convert question → embedding
Step 3: Find documents with SIMILAR embeddings → retrieve relevant docs
Step 4: Send relevant docs + question to LLM → get accurate answer
```

**3. Recommendations**
```
"You liked product A" → Find products with similar embeddings → Recommend!
```
